description: Start-here router and tradecraft baseline for any investigation into a person, company, domain, image or selector. Use for "investigate this person or company", "do OSINT on X", "where do I start", or any open-source intelligence, due diligence, background or attribution task. Applies across due diligence, fraud, threat intelligence, journalism and compliance. Reference at useosint.com/skills/investigate-anything.
